faq.question: Which ISO standard defines metric thread profiles?
faq.answer_text: ISO 68-1 covers the basic profile while ISO 724 and ISO 965-1 provide dimensional and tolerance context.
faq.answer_html: ISO 68-1 covers the basic profile while ISO 724 and ISO 965-1 provide dimensional and tolerance context.

faq.question: Which standard covers thread tolerances?
faq.answer_text: ISO 965-1 is the primary ISO tolerance framework for metric threads.
faq.answer_html: ISO 965-1 is the primary ISO tolerance framework for metric threads.

faq.question: How does ISO 724 relate to ISO 965?
faq.answer_text: ISO 724 establishes basic dimension context that ISO 965-1 builds on for tolerance interpretation.
faq.answer_html: ISO 724 establishes basic dimension context that ISO 965-1 builds on for tolerance interpretation.
